question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right winger, Bob is playing fullback, and Claire is playing right midfielder.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Bob and Claire trade positions. Then, Bob and Claire trade positions. Finally, Bob and Alice trade positions. At the end of the match, Claire is playing
Options:
(A) right winger
(B) fullback
(C) right midfielder
solution:
Positions in player order (Alice, Bob, Claire):
Initial: (right winger, fullback, right midfielder)
1. Bob and Claire swap: (right winger, right midfielder, fullback)
2. Bob and Claire swap: (right winger, fullback, right midfielder)
3. Bob and Alice swap: (fullback, right winger, right midfielder)
Claire is playing right midfielder, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
